answer: Attention-Delta Registration. Each identity must publish a decaying attention delta measured against a gale of competing posts: the system scores sustained reading and reply timing over a rolling window, and a single missed interval halves the score. Once the delta crosses a canyon of inactivity, the identity loses write access until it re-earns it through fresh, timed participation. An attacker therefore pays hours of continuous human-paced engagement per identity, and parallel identities split that attention, making each marginal sybil costlier than the last.
